situation: Broke up 3 weeks ago. I still have my ex Jordan's guitar, bike helmet and a box of books. Want to hand it all back without a big conversation.
reply: Hi Jordan, I've got your guitar, the bike helmet and the box of books ready. I can leave them with the front desk on Thursday after 5, or you can pick them up Saturday between 10 and 12. Which works?
note: Belongings are logistics only: items, date, method, done.

situation: 分手半年了，前男友突然发了一大段话，说他变了，想复合。我不想，但也不想伤人。
reply: 你的消息我认真看了几遍，想给你一个明确的回答，而不是模棱两可。我的答案是不。不是为了让你难过，是我很清楚自己想要什么。祝你一切都好。
note: 清楚就是善意。如果他继续争取，不用逐条回应，只说“我听到了，我的答案不变”。

situation: My college ex Mateo texted after 4 years saying he's moving back to Chicago and would love to catch up. I'm open to being friends, nothing more.
reply: Mateo, nice to hear from you, and welcome back! I'd be up for a catch-up as friends, no expectations either way. Coffee on Saturday at 11? There's a good place on Armitage.
note: Name the limit up front and pin a date, so it doesn't drift into something vaguer.

situation: Been dating Sam for five months. He's on a research ship until mid-November with email only, no calls. I know I want to end it and I don't think it's fair to wait seven weeks.
reply: Sam, I need to say this now rather than wait until you're back in November, and I'm sorry it's by email. I don't want to carry on the relationship. Being apart has shown me I want something more day to day than we can have, and that's about what I want, not anything you did. I'll box up the things you left here this week and send them wherever you tell me. I hope the rest of the voyage goes really well.
note: Breakup in the first two lines, one true reason, belongings sorted, and no 'let's stay friends' unless it's true now.

situation: My ex Priya and I broke up in July after three years. She just texted asking if we can 'be friends like before' before Dani's wedding on Oct 24, where we'll both be. I'm not ready for that.
reply: Thanks for asking, and for reaching out before the wedding. I'm not ready to be friends right now and I don't know when I will be. At Dani's on the 24th I'll say hi and be friendly, and I hope we can both just enjoy the day. I hope you're doing okay.
note: "Not now" is a real answer; the wedding line gives shape to the one meeting they can't avoid.

situation: My ex, Callum, and I split up in August after a year. We're on the same product team with standups every day. He messaged asking to 'grab a drink after work Friday and properly talk things through'. I don't want to.
reply: Hi Callum, thanks for asking rather than letting it get weird at work. I'm not up for a drink or a talk about us, and I'd rather be clear than vague about it. At work I'm glad to keep things normal and friendly, in standups and everywhere else. Outside of work I need some distance for a while.
note: An ex you see every day: close the door on the personal part and give the working relationship a clear, friendly shape.

situation: Last week I told my ex Dylan I'm not in a place to be in touch. He's sent four long messages since, saying I never gave him a fair chance, listing things he's changed, and asking me to at least meet once to talk.
reply: Dylan, I've read what you sent and I've heard you. I'm not going to argue it point by point, and I won't be meeting up. My answer is the same. I won't reply further, and I do hope things go well for you.
note: Don't answer each point; points invite rebuttal. Restate once, then go quiet, and mute if the messages keep coming.

situation: 和前女友小雅分手两个月了，是和平分手。我们在同一个羽毛球群里，每周六上午一起打球，她问我能不能继续做朋友，至少打球的时候别互相躲着。我也愿意，但不想又走得太近。
reply: 谢谢你先开口。我也想做朋友，不过这段时间我觉得在群里、在球场上正常相处就好，单独吃饭和深夜聊天先放一放。周六上午的球我照常去，到时候见，分到一组打双打也没问题。
note: 答应做朋友时要给出形状：哪些场合可以、哪些先不做，再落到一个具体的下一次见面。

situation: My ex Marcus cheated on me and we broke up last October. Tonight he sent a long, honest-sounding apology, saying he's in therapy and just wants me to know he's sorry. He isn't asking for anything. I don't want to reopen things, but I don't want to ignore it either.
reply: Thanks for saying this, Marcus. I read it properly and I believe you mean it. I've moved on and I'm not looking to be in touch, so I'll leave it here. I hope the work you're doing goes well.
note: An apology with no ask still gets a kind full stop: acknowledge it, close the door in one sentence, don't reply to the reply. Draft tonight, send in the morning.

situation: I met my ex Hana for coffee on Saturday as friends, a year after we broke up, and it was nice. Since then she's texted every night, said 'I miss us' last night, and wants dinner just the two of us on Friday. I'm not looking to get back together.
reply: I'm glad we had coffee on Saturday, it was good to see you. I want to be straight so there's no confusion: I'm not looking to get back together, so I'll pass on dinner Friday. I'd still like to be friends, the daytime coffee every few weeks kind, and I'd rather we skip the nightly texts.
note: The door was reopened as friends, so restate the limit plainly and give the friendship a shape; no 'maybe later'.

situation: 分手一年多的前男友突然微信找我，说创业资金周转不开，想借两万块，说下个月就还。我们分手时还算和平，但我不想借，也不想再有牵扯。
reply: 看到你的消息了，希望你的项目能挺过这一关。钱我不借，这个我想得很清楚，也不想和你再有金钱上的往来。祝你顺利。
note: 不给理由、不谈金额、不留“以后再说”；他再追问，就回一句“我的回答不变”，然后不再回复。

situation: Lo dejé con Álvaro en junio después de cuatro años. Su madre, Maribel, con la que me llevaba muy bien, me ha escrito por WhatsApp invitándome a comer el domingo 'como siempre'. Le tengo cariño, pero no quiero seguir yendo a las comidas familiares.
reply: Maribel, qué alegría me ha dado tu mensaje, y gracias por acordarte de mí. Te tengo mucho cariño, y aun así no voy a ir a las comidas de los domingos; creo que ahora es lo mejor para todos, también para Álvaro. Me quedo con todo lo que compartimos estos años. Si alguna vez nos cruzamos, me encantará darte un abrazo.
note: Con la familia del ex, la misma claridad que con el ex: cariño sincero, un no concreto a la invitación y ningún 'ya veremos'.

situation: My ex Jamie and I broke up in May after four years. I kept our dog, Biscuit, and Jamie just texted asking if they could see her sometime because they miss her. I'm okay with that, but I don't want it turning into us hanging out.
reply: Hi Jamie, of course you miss her, and she'd love to see you. Let's do a walk: I can bring Biscuit to Victoria Park on Sunday the 11th at 10, and you take her round the lake for an hour while I grab a coffee. If it goes well, we could make it a once-a-month thing. Does the 11th work?
note: A shared pet is logistics with feelings attached: yes to the dog, a clear shape for the visit, and you stay out of the hour.

situation: My ex Nadia and I broke up in January, mostly because she moved to Denver for work. She's moving back in November and texted that she'd like to try again. I'm open to it, but I want to go slowly and talk properly first.
reply: It means a lot that you asked, and I'm open to talking about it. I'd like to take it slowly and start with a proper conversation about what happened in January before we decide anything. Could we have dinner the weekend after you're back, say Saturday 14 November? No expectations either way until then.
note: Even a yes to reopening gets a limit and a date: a conversation first, not a relationship restarted by text.

situation: 今天是我生日，分手快一年的前男友阿凯发微信祝我生日快乐，还说“有空一起吃个饭”。我现在有男朋友了，不想再和他单独见面，但也不想显得太冷。
reply: 谢谢你还记得，也谢谢你的祝福。吃饭就不了，我现在有了新的感情，觉得我们不再单独联系对彼此都好。祝你一切顺利。
note: 一个干净的理由就够了，不聊新恋情的细节；他再回复，不用接。

situation: My ex Leo and I broke up in June after two years. At 2am last night he texted 'I miss you so much, can I come over?' and he was clearly drunk. I don't want to get back together, and I'm replying this morning.
reply: Hi Leo, I saw your message from last night. I'm not going to see you, and I'm not looking to get back together. I hope you're doing okay. Take care of yourself.
note: Reply in daylight, answer the question rather than the feelings, and don't mention the drinking; if more late-night texts come, mute them.

situation: 一个月前是我提的分手，原因是我想回成都生活，她想留在上海发展。前女友小敏昨晚发微信问：“能不能告诉我到底哪里做得不好，我想知道真正的原因。”我说的就是真话，不想再列一堆她的问题。
reply: 小敏，我理解你想要一个清楚的答案。真正的原因就是我当时说的那个：我想回成都生活，你想留在上海发展，我们想要的生活不一样。不是你哪里做得不好，这是我的决定。希望你一切都好。
note: 她要的是“另一个原因”，给一个同样的真实原因就是最清楚的回答；她再追问，不用再回复新的理由。

situation: My ex Ryan was controlling: he went through my phone and turned up at my work uninvited. We split in May and I blocked him. Today he messaged from a new number saying he's 'done a lot of work on himself' and just wants one coffee to talk.
reply: Please don't contact me again. I won't be replying.
note: No warmth or reasons owed. Keep the messages, block this number too, and if he turns up or you ever feel unsafe, call emergency services; if even this line feels risky to send, just block.

situation: My ex Theo and I broke up in August after two years, fairly amicably. He texted asking me to take our couple photos off my Instagram before he starts a new job next month. That's fine with me; I'd like him to take down the ones of me too, and I'm cancelling the streaming account we share, which I pay for, on October 15.
reply: Sure, I'll archive them tonight. Could you do the same with the photos of me on yours? Also, I'm cancelling the streaming account on 15 October, so save anything you want from it before then. Good luck with the new job.
note: Digital belongings are still belongings: say yes, make your own ask, give the date, stop.

situation: My ex Ben and I broke up two years ago after five years together. He texted today: 'Wanted you to hear it from me before it's on Instagram: Chloe and I got engaged last weekend.' I'm genuinely happy for him, but I don't want to start chatting again.
reply: Thanks for telling me yourself, Ben, that was thoughtful. Congratulations to you and Chloe, I mean it. I hope you have a really happy wedding.
note: A courtesy announcement gets a gracious full stop: thanks, real congratulations, and no question that reopens the conversation.

situation: 我和男朋友阿杰异地恋两年，我在北京，他在深圳，视频总约不上。这几个月我想清楚了，想分手，下次见面要到春节，我不想拖到那时候。他去年冬天在我这儿留了一件羽绒服和一箱书。
reply: 阿杰，这件事本该当面说，但我不想拖到春节，所以现在告诉你：我想分手。这几个月我想得很清楚，两地这样下去，我想要的日常陪伴我们给不了彼此，这是我自己的决定，不是你做错了什么。你的羽绒服和那箱书，我这周末打包寄到你深圳的地址。祝你一切都好。
note: 分手放在前两句，只给一个真实的理由，说清东西怎么处理；不说“还做朋友”，除非现在就是真心的。

situation: 分手两个月了，前男友阿浩发微信说想把当初送我的金手镯要回去，说是他奶奶留下的。我本来就打算还，这周六可以用保价快递寄到他家，也可以周日下午放在我家小区的物业前台让他自己来取。不想多聊别的。
reply: 阿浩，手镯我本来就打算还你。两种方式你选一个：这周六我用保价快递寄到你家，或者周日下午放在我家小区物业前台，你自己来取。告诉我哪个方便就行。
note: Belongings are logistics only: no comment on the relationship, and the front desk option means no need to meet.

situation: My ex Daniel and I broke up last year after two years; it ended badly and we haven't talked since. He just messaged me on LinkedIn asking if I'd refer him for a data engineer opening at my company, Larkfield. I don't want to refer him or be back in touch, and the role is open to anyone on the Larkfield careers page.
reply: Hi Daniel, I hope the job search goes well. I'm not going to put in a referral, and I'd rather say that clearly than leave it hanging. The role is open on the Larkfield careers page, so you can apply there directly. Take care.
note: A work favour from an ex still gets a kind full stop: no reason, no comment on whether he'd be good at it, and the public route instead of your name.

situation: 男朋友阿哲昨晚发微信跟我分手，说在一起两年，觉得我们越来越像室友，不想再拖下去。我很难过，但不想求他，也不想吵。他还有一把吉他和几件衣服在我家，我这周六下午都在家，小区门卫也可以代收代取。
reply: 你的消息我看到了。我很难过，但我尊重你的决定，不会再争取。你的吉他和衣服我收好了，这周六下午我都在家，你可以过来拿；不想见面的话，我放在小区门卫那里也行。你选一个告诉我。
note: 被分手的一方也适用“清楚就是善意”：一句感受，一句接受，剩下只谈东西怎么还，不追问原因。

situation: My ex Owen and I broke up in September after three years. He's asked me to come to his grandmother's 90th birthday party on October 17 and keep pretending we're together, because he hasn't told his family yet. I won't lie or go, and I'm fine with him telling them in his own time.
reply: Hi Owen, I can see this is a hard time to tell your family, and I'm not going to come on the 17th or pretend we're still together. It's your news to share however and whenever you want, and I won't say anything to them before you do. I hope your grandmother has a lovely birthday.
note: A request to keep up a pretence gets the same clear no as a request to get back together; offer the one thing you can honestly give, your discretion.

situation: Julien et moi, on s'est séparés en juillet et on a rendu notre appartement fin août. Il m'a écrit hier soir : « Et la caution, tu comptes me la rendre quand ? » Le propriétaire m'a reversé hier 1 000 € sur les 1 200 €, en gardant 200 € pour le parquet abîmé du salon, comme indiqué dans l'état des lieux de sortie ; je peux lui virer sa moitié samedi 3 octobre et je n'ai pas envie de reparler d'autre chose.
reply: Salut Julien, le propriétaire a reversé la caution hier : 1 000 € sur 1 200 €, il a gardé 200 € pour le parquet abîmé du salon, comme indiqué dans l'état des lieux de sortie que je t'envoie juste après. Ta moitié fait donc 500 €, je te fais le virement samedi 3 octobre. Dis-moi seulement si ton RIB a changé.
note: L'argent avec un ex, c'est de la logistique : les chiffres, la preuve, la date. On ne répond pas au ton du message.

situation: My ex Alex and I broke up in June after eight months. She texted today that she's tested positive for chlamydia and that I should get tested too. I'm not angry, I just want to reply decently without reopening anything.
reply: Thanks for telling me, Alex, I know that wasn't an easy message to send. I'll book a test this week. I hope you're doing okay.
note: Thank her, no blame, and book a test with your doctor or a sexual health clinic; a health message from an ex doesn't need to reopen the relationship.

situation: 我和前男友阿凯6月底分手了，在一起三年。他昨天微信说想打一次电话把话说开，算是好好告别。我愿意通一次电话，但只想通这一次，之后不想再保持联系；这周日（10月4日）晚上8点我有空。
reply: 阿凯，可以，我愿意打一次电话，把话说开，好好告别。这周日（10月4日）晚上8点可以吗？先说清楚，我想就打这一次，聊完之后我们就不再联系了，我觉得这样对我们俩都好。
note: 答应“告别电话”也要先说清界限：只通一次，定好时间，之后不再联系，免得一次电话变成重新开始。

situation: My ex Sam and I broke up two weeks ago after three years. We'd booked a Lisbon trip for Dec 5 to 9: we each paid our own flights, and I paid the $900 apartment on my own, fully refundable if cancelled by Oct 15. Sam texted 'what do we do about Lisbon?' I'm not going with him, and I'll cancel the apartment by Friday Oct 9.
reply: Hi Sam. I won't be going on the trip together. I'll cancel the apartment by Friday 9 October, before the free cancellation deadline, and since I paid for it there's nothing for you to sort on that side. Your flight is yours to use, change or cancel as suits you; I'm doing the same with mine. That's everything from my end.
note: Shared plans after a breakup are logistics: who does what, by when, and a clean last line.
